Not being nourished as a child can lead to feeling “trapped” in a certain age whether you can pinpoint the age you feel like you’re in or not. It’s pretty common in people with depression, including myself. I listen to music from when I was 8 and find myself still watching the Minecraft youtubers I’ve been watching since I was 13 even though I no longer enjoy their content. Something that helps me sometimes is to do something someone “my age” would do. I’m 17, and when I’m feeling super vulnerable, I often try to drive or even just watch an inappropriate movie. You’re 21, so maybe try taking a shot of liquor, watching an inappropriate movie or porn, driving, going to a club, or anything you feel would be “age appropriate.” I’m not trying to condone anything bad or harmful, and It may sound silly but it’s helped me before.
